keyPoints: Samkon tribhuj me kon θ ke liye: sin θ = lamb/karn, cos θ = aadhar/karn, tan θ = lamb/aadhar — lamb θ ke saamne ki bhuja hai.
cosec, sec, cot inke vyutkram hain — sin ka cosec, cos ka sec, tan ka cot; chhah anupat kul hote hain.
tan θ = sin θ / cos θ; yaad rakho: lamb/karn, aadhar/karn, lamb/aadhar — isi kram me sin, cos, tan.
Khaas maan: sin 30° = 1/2, cos 60° = 1/2, tan 45° = 1, sin 90° = 1 — sarani rat lo, har pariksha me aate hain.
Mool sarv-samikayen: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1; 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ; 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ — siddhiyon me sabse zyada kaam aati hain.
Poorak kon: sin(90°-θ) = cos θ, cos(90°-θ) = sin θ — 30 aur 60 ka jod 90, isliye maan palat jaate hain.
Aam galti: sin(A+B) ko sin A + sin B samajhna — trikonmiti anupat jod par nahi bat-te.
